mechanics_text: Mines float wherever they were launched and only detonate within proximity of any ship.
They have a limited time to detonate after they are released (40 seconds for AMR Saber).
After this time has passed, and it has not detonated, the mine will simply vanish without explosion.
version_notes: Mine — deploys at launch position, detonates on proximity. 40s lifetime. 500m trigger radius.
